public_definitions: Review the coastal water temperature dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period coastal water temperature change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.

Coastal water temperature change route: Route the 2005 to 2015 coastal water temperature change to substantial-change follow-up, Keep the 2005 to 2015 coastal water temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation, Route the coastal water temperature record to archive and background filing.
